faqs.q: How do I renew a library book?
faqs.a: Log in to the library portal, open My Loans and press Renew. Each book can be renewed twice unless another student has reserved it.

faqs.q: Where can I print my assignment?
faqs.a: Printing stations are on the ground floor of the library and in the computer lab. Print credit is topped up through the student portal.

faqs.q: How do I reset my university email password?
faqs.a: Use the self-service password page, verify with your phone code, then choose a new password of at least twelve characters.

faqs.q: What are the opening hours of the gym?
faqs.a: The campus gym is open 6am to 10pm on weekdays and 8am to 6pm at weekends. Bring your student card to enter.

faqs.q: How can I apply for an exam extension?
faqs.a: Submit the extension form with supporting evidence to the course office at least two days before the exam date.

faqs.q: Where do I collect my student ID card?
faqs.a: ID cards are issued at the welcome desk in the main building. Bring a photo ID and your enrolment confirmation.

faqs.q: How do I book a study room?
faqs.a: Study rooms are booked through the library website for up to two hours a day. Groups of three or more get priority for the large rooms.

faqs.q: Is there free wifi on campus?
faqs.a: Connect to the campus wifi network and sign in with your university username. Guests can request a day pass at reception.

faqs.q: How do I pay my tuition fees in instalments?
faqs.a: Choose the instalment plan in the finance portal before the term starts. Payments are split into three equal monthly amounts.

faqs.q: Who do I talk to about stress or mental health?
faqs.a: The counselling service offers free confidential appointments. Book online or drop in at the wellbeing centre between 10am and 4pm.

faqs.q: How do I join a student society?
faqs.a: Browse the societies page at the students union website and click Join. Most societies charge a small yearly membership fee.

faqs.q: Where is the cheapest place to eat on campus?
faqs.a: The union canteen serves subsidised hot meals and the vending hall has snacks. Both accept the student meal card.

faqs.q: How do I get a transcript of my grades?
faqs.a: Request an official transcript in the registry portal. Digital copies arrive in one working day and paper copies take a week.

faqs.q: What should I do if I lose my laptop on campus?
faqs.a: Report it to campus security straight away and file a lost property form. Items handed in are kept at security for thirty days.

faqs.q: How can I change my course or major?
faqs.a: Speak to your academic advisor, then submit the change of programme form before the end of the second week of term.

faqs.q: Is there parking for students who drive?
faqs.a: Student parking permits are sold through the transport office. The north car park is the cheapest and has a free shuttle bus to the main building.
